decision.explanation: The question asks when the Douglas County Courthouse was built. Multiple documents provide conflicting dates depending on the specific courthouse and location. Document D1S2 states the Nebraska courthouse was built in 1912, while D2S2 claims it was built in 1895. D3S2 and D4S1 refer to the Wisconsin courthouse built in 1918–1919. D5S2 and D6S5 refer to the Illinois courthouse built in 1913. Since the question does not specify a state, all valid referents are preserved.
